verdict.rationale: No document states a no-training policy or a training opt-out. The only support is indirect: LanceDB is an Apache-2.0 open-source, embeddable database whose storage runs on the user's own local NVMe, EBS, EFS or S3-compatible object stores, so self-hosting keeps data under the user's control. Enterprise SOC 2 Type II, HIPAA and GDPR compliance adds general privacy posture but does not address model training. missing for 10: explicit vendor policy that customer data is never used to train models, a documented opt-out control for LanceDB Cloud/Enterprise, data-usage terms, independent corroboration.
